articles.title: Securitize eyes acquisitions with $400 million war chest after going public, CEO says
articles.snippet: Following its NYSE debut, Securitize CEO Carlos Domingo said the firm wants to expand its institutional tokenization platform rather than buy competitors.

articles.title: Coinbase AI draws backlash after erroneously publishing World Cup result before kickoff
articles.snippet: CEO Brian Armstrong investigated, and the firm said it made updates to prevent future AI-generated inaccuracies.

articles.title: I am contemplating selling some of my bitcoin for gold, veteran trader Peter Brandt says
articles.snippet: Veteran trader Peter Brandt said gold is going to gain substantially on bitcoin.

articles.title: Dubai tops Asian crypto hubs, Taiwan passes crypto laws: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Japan's SBI Crypto shuts down 12th largest Bitcoin mining pool in the world, Russia gears up to launch digital ruble despite EU sanctions, and more: Asia Express.

articles.title: South Africa proposes crypto tax guidance under existing framework
articles.snippet: South Africa’s tax authority proposed draft guidance clarifying how crypto assets are taxed under existing income and capital gains tax rules, seeking public input until Aug. 31.
